name: Front-of-house engineer station
placement: Centered in the back third of the audience, behind the last seating, so the engineer hears what guests hear; keep a clear lane for cable to the stage and a power run.
modeling: A black-skirted table with a console (tilted screen, fader strips), a laptop, a rack case under the table, and a stool behind it. The 2.4 x 1.4 x 1.2 m size is an ESTIMATE: no page was opened; see estimated_sizes_p6. The simpler DJ table is foh_mixer.
